name: tres-asc845-swap-reprice-skill
description: Reprice swap transaction legs under ASC 845 (Nonmonetary Transactions) to ensure clearing accounts net to zero. Use this skill whenever the user wants to: reprice swaps, fix clearing account residuals, apply equal-value exchange to swap legs, run setBatchUseCounterpartyFiatValue, zero out a clearing account, apply ASC 845, fix swap pricing mismatches, ensure no gain/loss on swaps, or close a month where a swaps/trade clearing account has a residual balance. Also trigger when the user mentions "counterparty fiat value", "swap repricing", "clearing account net to zero", or "equal value exchange".
